thread:
Anya: Heads-up — I'm landing a TF module refactor in infra/modules/compute. Need a quick sanity check on provider pinning, lockfile, and secretpath wiring before I cut the canary deploy. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/482

Ravin: looking now; main question — are we hoisting `provider` to root? I see you removed provider blocks inside the module.

Anya: yep hoisting to root. I updated root module with `providers = { aws = aws }` and removed provider blocks from the child modules. Ran `terraform init -upgrade` locally, no errors.

Maria: did you update the providers.lock file? last time we had a subtle provider mismatch when merging across branches.

Anya: I ran `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` and checked in the lockfile. Snippet from the `versions.tf` I added:
```
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { version = "~> 4.50", source = "hashicorp/aws" }
  }
}
```

infra-bot: terraform-plan-checker: plan OK in staging for branch/feature/refactor-compute — summary: 1 to destroy, 0 to create, 3 to change. Plan: https://ci.internal/redwood/plan/98765 :white_check_mark:

Sam: quick note on k8s secret wiring — modules/compute/secret.tf used `module_secret_path = var.secret_path`. Are we mapping that to `k8s/infra/compute` in the cluster? if not cronjobs will fail on startup.

Anya: confirmed mapping to `k8s/infra/compute` and migrated secret name to `redwood-compute-creds`. Also added a rotation hook to the terraform module to call the secret-sync job.

Leo: for the canary rollout, I recommend: `rollout_delay = "15m"` and `max_unavailable = 1` (so we don't drop capacity). Also add a fallback routing policy for model variants if the primary provider is unavailable. ping @Michael (ops) for egress/network window.

Michael (ops): got it — we can open a short egress rule change window at 21:00 UTC. Keep me posted if you need a CIDR or port tweak.

Maria: LGTM from infra/security side assuming the lockfile is included in the PR and you document the state move steps. Please add a short `State migration` section in the PR description with the exact `terraform state mv` commands.

Anya: will do. Plan: push PR with lockfile and migration steps, schedule canary for 21:30 UTC. @Ravin can you review after I push? :pray: 

Ravin: yup I'll review asap after you push. If plan in staging looks good I'll approve and we can proceed with canary.

Anya: thanks all — pushing now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled at 2024-11-12T21:30:00Z (id: canary-20241112-482). Notifications will follow on status.
